summary: The Catalog Community Sync notes for 12 August 2026 list two items and record no discussion. topics.title: Labels in the REST catalog read path: final concerns before vote
topics.summary: Andrei asked for any final concerns before starting a vote and for reviews. The reference implementation is a stack: #17337 adds labels to the load table/view read path and is the foundation, #17410 exposes labels on the loaded table via SupportsLabels, and #17411 exposes catalog labels in Spark 4.1 through a metadata table and DESCRIBE. The notes do not record whether concerns were raised.
